payload.title: Fall back to AWS Batch safely when local work is unavailable
payload.description:
## Behavior and acceptance
Given an unclaimed job after the grace period, when cloud policy permits, then submit bounded AWS Batch work. Local and cloud workers acquire atomic fenced claims; late claims, duplicate messages, and retries cannot publish competing authoritative results. A crashed/stalled worker has heartbeat/lease expiry and bounded recovery; distinguish the claim window from maximum render duration. Cancellation and retries are observable and bounded.

## Ownership
Babulus rendering platform; VideoML public project/artifact contract

## Verification
Specify Given/When/Then fixtures before implementation and link results before closing. This issue is planned work, not a claim of shipped functionality.
